title: Graduated Canary Rollback Sentinel with Smoke-Rewind and Traffic Quarantine
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Introduces a graduated-canary sentinel controller that performs staged promotions with a smoke-rewind automated rollback and traffic quarantine. Backwards compatible with existing rollout policies. Improves safety for short-lived regressions and reduces noisy false-positive rollbacks.
description:
Motivation: Large-scale rollouts occasionally encounter brief regressions (third-party infra blips, cold-cache anomalies) that should be quarantined rather than fully rolling back a model. This PR adds a Rollback Sentinel controller that integrates with the rollout runtime to: 1) perform graduated canary promotions across multiple slices, 2) quarantine traffic to a lightweight shadow lane when transient anomalies are detected, 3) perform a smoke-rewind (time-bounded replay of in-flight requests) to determine if anomalies were transient or persistent, and 4) trigger safe rollback with snapshot-based revert.

Design summary: The sentinel sits alongside the existing orchestrator. It consumes metric streams (latency, error-rate, model-score-drift) and the Request Audit stream. Key behaviors: - Graduated promotion windows: promote 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% with per-step smoke checks. - Quarantine lane: when noise is detected, new traffic is diverted to a quarantine shadow with lower resource priority and captured requests for replay. - Smoke-rewind: the controller replays the last N captured requests (configurable, default 500) through the candidate model in a sandbox using production input fingerprints to check for deterministic regressions. - Snapshot-based rollback: if smoke-rewind detects a regression beyond configured threshold, the controller triggers an atomic traffic revert and marks the revision for investigation. - Observability: adds per-cohort tracing spans, sample-level hashes for replay determinism, and new alert rules.

Compatibility and configuration: Feature gated behind rollout.sentinel.enabled (off by default). Configurable via rollout policy manifest: promotion_schedule, quarantine_thresholds, smoke_rewind_window, replay_parallelism. Works with both hosted and dedicated deployments; private deployments can override sample retention TTL.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests for decision logic and threshold gating. - Integration harness simulates latency spikes and transient errors; validated that quarantine prevents full rollback for >90% of transient cases. - Load test on perf-canary with 10k RPS ramp validated that graduated promotion doesn't exceed burst limits.

Files changed: controller/core/rollback_sentinel.go, controller/scheduler/promotion_plan.go, telemetry/schemas/rollout_telemetry.v1.yaml, replay/replayer/sandbox.go, docs/rollouts/graduated-canary.md, examples/rollouts/graduated-canary-policy.yaml, tests/integration/smoke_rewind_test.go, charts/rollout/values.yaml, api/openapi/rollout_policy.json

Migration notes: No data migration. If feature is enabled, rollout controller will begin capturing sample fingerprints; retention respects configured TTL. Ensure S3/MinIO bucket for replay artifacts is provisioned for heavy sampling.

Related: ENG-9876 (safetynet design), PM-321 (product acceptance criteria).

review_comments:
Lina Xu: Can we make the smoke_rewind_window default smaller in prod? 500 replays at once is heavy.
Priya: Default is 500 but replay_parallelism defaults to 8; updated docs to make recommendation and added a helm value to cap total concurrency.

Marco Alvarez: Need a fail-safe so that quarantine doesn't keep traffic sidelined indefinitely if the replay infra is degraded.
Priya: Added a quarantine_expiry TTL and a fallback that promotes to previous stable model after expiry with an incident note.

Samir Patel: Is the replay deterministic across quantized/onnx backends? Concern about false positives.
Priya: Added deterministic hashing and a backend adapter that runs replays on a canonical runtime path; noted in docs caveat for some experimental kernels.

Lina Xu: telemetry looks good but add a percentile latency metric for quarantine lane.
Priya: Added p50/p95/p99 for quarantine lane and a dashboard snapshot in docs.
